raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# PR type

- [ ] Bug Fix
- [x] New Feature
- [x] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Refs #10307

This PR replaces the AutoAWQ export path with GPTQModel while preserving the existing `--quant_method awq` interface.

It also:

- Adds `ms-swift[awq]` as an optional dependency.
- Supports image calibration for Qwen2-VL.
- Preserves the `--quant_batch_size -1` behavior.
- Documents known dependency conflicts and current export limitations.

Issue #10307 concerns dependency conflicts during AWQ model fine-tuning. This PR is related to that issue but does not claim to resolve the fine-tuning problem.

## Current limitations

This implementation is not yet a drop-in replacement for every previous AWQ use case:

- Explicit `--device_map` and some custom model-loading options are not supported.
- Multimodal AWQ calibration currently supports Qwen2-VL images only.
- Qwen2-VL was tested with a randomly initialized small model, not a pretrained model or an accuracy benchmark.
- The optional dependency does not resolve the declared conflicts between GPTQModel, SwanLab, and ms-opencompass.

## Experiment results

Tests were performed on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 D with Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.11.0+cu130, Transformers 5.14.1, GPTQModel 7.3.2, and vLLM 0.25.1.

- Qwen3-0.6B AWQ, GPTQ, and GPTQ v2 GPU exports completed. vLLM loaded each exported model and generated text.
- The tested GPTQ v2 export was converted to GPTQ v1 during saving; the exported configuration recorded the actual format.
- A nonzero LoRA adapter was merged before AWQ export.
- A synthetic small Qwen2-VL model completed image calibration, AWQ export, reload, and generation with image inputs.
- `--quant_batch_size -1` completed an AWQ GPU export.
- The opt-in GPU integration suite passed for AWQ, GPTQ, and GPTQ v2:

  ```bash
  SWIFT_TEST_QUANT_MODEL=/path/to/Qwen3-0.6B \
  SWIFT_TEST_QUANT_DATASET=/path/to/c4_demo.jsonl \
  python -m pytest -q tests/export/test_quant_gpu_integration.py
  ```

- AWQ unit tests, GPTQ saved-format tests, the optional-dependency metadata test, and `pre-commit run --all-files` passed.

The diagnostic image still had dependency conflicts: GPTQModel 7.3.2 requires protobuf >=7.34 and NumPy 2.2.6 on Python 3.12, while SwanLab 0.9.2 requires protobuf <7 and ms-opencompass 0.1.6 requires NumPy <2. Therefore, `pip check` did not pass for the complete diagnostic image.

AI assistance was used to develop and test this change.

# Checklist

- [ ] I have linked the related issue above, if there is one.
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct.
- [ ] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable).
- [ ] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.

+
+如果同一环境需要 AWQ、SwanLab 或 ms-opencompass，先确认所选版本的依赖声明存在共同解；上述冲突版本不能通过调整安装顺序解决。若暂时没有共同解，可以将量化、训练和评测放在各自的环境中。不要使用 `--no-deps` 将 `pip check` 中的冲突视为已解决。实际依赖可能随版本和 Python 版本变化，还应验证 PyTorch、CUDA、Transformers 和其他已安装组件。上述测试镜像自身仍有其他依赖冲突，AWQ 导出测试通过不代表整个镜像兼容。
+
 我们提供了一系列脚本展现SWIFT的量化导出能力：
 - 支持[AWQ](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/export/quantize/awq.sh)/[GPTQ](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/export/quantize/gptq.sh)/[GPTQ v2](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/export/quantize/gptq_v2.sh)/[BNB](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/export/quantize/bnb.sh)量化导出。
-- 多模态量化: 支持使用GPTQ和AWQ对多模态模型进行量化，其中AWQ支持的多模态模型有限。参考[这里](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/tree/main/examples/export/quantize/mllm)。
+- 多模态量化: GPTQ支持多模态模型；AWQ目前不支持多模态校准。参考[这里](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/tree/main/examples/export/quantize/mllm)。
 - 更多系列模型的支持: 支持[Bert](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/tree/main/examples/export/quantize/bert)，[Reward Model](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/tree/main/examples/export/quantize/reward_model)的量化导出。
 - 使用SWIFT量化导出的模型支持使用vllm/sglang/lmdeploy进行推理加速；也支持使用QLoRA继续进行SFT/RLHF。
 
 
+AWQ 使用 GPTQModel 生成带零点的 GEMM 格式权重。目前支持文本校准，使用 safetensors 和未量化的模型；LoRA 需要先使用 `--merge_lora true` 合并。AWQ 不支持在导出时添加特殊 token、指定 `--device_map` 或设置自定义模型加载参数。模型架构须受 GPTQModel 支持，安装时请检查与现有 PyTorch、Transformers 和其他依赖的兼容性。
+
 使用 GPTQ v2 量化时，后端可能将对称量化权重保存为 GPTQ v1 格式。导出配置会记录实际保存的格式，以便正确重新加载模型。
 
 ## 推送模型

 
+`awq` is an independent optional extra; it is not included in the base installation or the `all` extra. Check the environment's dependency constraints before installing and run `python -m pip check` afterward. The following observations apply to the specific versions tested, not to all releases:
+
+| Component | Tested version or known constraint |
+| --- | --- |
+| AWQ export test environment | Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.11.0+cu130, Transformers 5.14.1, GPTQModel 7.3.2 |
+| GPTQModel 7.3.2 | Requires Python >=3.10; on Python 3.12, requires NumPy 2.2.6 and protobuf >=7.34.0 |
+| SwanLab 0.9.2 | Requires protobuf <7, conflicting with GPTQModel 7.3.2 |
+| ms-opencompass 0.1.6 | Requires NumPy <2, conflicting with GPTQModel 7.3.2 |
+
+If AWQ, SwanLab, or ms-opencompass are needed in the same environment, first confirm that the chosen versions' declared requirements have a common solution; changing the installation order cannot resolve the conflicts above. If no common solution is available, use separate environments for quantization, training, and evaluation. Do not treat `--no-deps` as a resolution of `pip check` conflicts. Requirements may change by package and Python version; also verify PyTorch, CUDA, Transformers, and other installed components. The test image has other dependency conflicts, so successful AWQ export does not establish compatibility of the entire image.
+
 We provide a series of scripts to demonstrate SWIFT's quantization export capabilities:
 
 - Supports [AWQ](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/export/quantize/awq.sh)/[GPTQ](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/export/quantize/gptq.sh)/[GPTQ v2](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/export/quantize/gptq_v2.sh)/[BNB](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/blob/main/examples/export/quantize/bnb.sh) quantization exports.
-- Multimodal quantization: Supports quantizing multimodal models using GPTQ and AWQ, with limited multimodal models supported by AWQ. Refer to [here](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/tree/main/examples/export/quantize/mllm).
+- Multimodal quantization: GPTQ supports multimodal models; AWQ does not currently support multimodal calibration. Refer to [here](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/tree/main/examples/export/quantize/mllm).
 - Support for more model series: Supports quantization exports for [BERT](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/tree/main/examples/export/quantize/bert) and [Reward Model](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift/tree/main/examples/export/quantize/reward_model).
 - Models exported with SWIFT's quantization support inference acceleration using vllm/sglang/lmdeploy; they also support further SFT/RLHF using QLoRA.
 
 
+AWQ uses GPTQModel to produce GEMM weights with zero points. It supports text calibration, safetensors, and unquantized source models; merge LoRA adapters first using `--merge_lora true`. Adding special tokens, setting `--device_map`, or passing custom model loading arguments during AWQ export are not supported. The model architecture must be supported by GPTQModel. Check compatibility with the existing PyTorch, Transformers, and other dependencies when installing it.
+
 GPTQ backends may save symmetric weights in GPTQ v1 format even when GPTQ v2 is used during quantization. The exported configuration records the saved format so the model reloads correctly.

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from importlib.metadata import PathDistribution
+from packaging.requirements import Requirement
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def test_awq_backend_is_an_opt_in_dependency(tmp_path):
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'setup.py', 'egg_info', '--egg-base',
+                    str(tmp_path)],
+                   cwd=root,
+                   check=True,
+                   capture_output=True,
+                   text=True)
+    metadata = PathDistribution(next(tmp_path.glob('*.egg-info')))
+    requirements = [Requirement(item) for item in metadata.requires or []]
+    gptqmodel = [item for item in requirements if item.name.lower() == 'gptqmodel']
+    assert len(gptqmodel) == 1
+    assert str(gptqmodel[0].specifier) == '>=7.3.2'
+    assert gptqmodel[0].marker.evaluate({'extra': 'awq'})
+    assert not gptqmodel[0].marker.evaluate({'extra': ''})
+    assert not gptqmodel[0].marker.evaluate({'extra': 'all'})

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+"""Opt-in GPU export regression with a local Qwen3 model and calibration dataset."""
+import json
+import os
+import pytest
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import torch
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('method', ['awq', 'gptq', 'gptq_v2'])
+def test_qwen3_quantization_export(tmp_path, method):
+    model = os.environ.get('SWIFT_TEST_QUANT_MODEL')
+    dataset = os.environ.get('SWIFT_TEST_QUANT_DATASET')
+    if not model or not dataset or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        pytest.skip('Set SWIFT_TEST_QUANT_MODEL and SWIFT_TEST_QUANT_DATASET and provide a CUDA GPU')
+
+    output_dir = tmp_path / method
+    script = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'swift' / 'cli' / 'export.py'
+    command = [
+        sys.executable,
+        str(script), '--model', model, '--model_type', 'qwen3', '--template', 'qwen3', '--dataset', dataset,
+        '--output_dir',
+        str(output_dir), '--quant_method', method, '--quant_bits', '4', '--group_size', '128', '--quant_n_samples',
+        '32', '--quant_batch_size', '1', '--max_length', '256'
+    ]
+    subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=1800)
+    config = json.loads((output_dir / 'config.json').read_text())['quantization_config']
+    assert config['bits'] == 4
+    assert config['group_size'] == 128
+    assert config['quant_method'] == ('awq' if method == 'awq' else 'gptq')
+    if method == 'awq':
+        assert config['zero_point'] is True
+        assert config['version'].lower() == 'gemm'
+    assert list(output_dir.glob('*.safetensors'))
